title: Fonts
author: @lunokjod
description: Every face the board can read, in one page: /fonts gathers the flash, the card and the fonts an app carries, and the page opens one of each format the system knows and draws it with its own letters. A face given to it —from Files or `open ttf <path>`— opens straight on its own page, and the extensions it claims are the ones the loader really reads: ttf, bdf, pcf and lfont. A `.otf` of CFF outlines is not one of them and the loader says so instead of drawing a blank.
